title: Regional Advocacy Councils (RACs)
content: Mobilizing ADA’s Advocates to support policy change benefitting people with diabetes and prediabetes. The Regional Advocacy Councils (RACs) are region-based volunteer groups of Diabetes Advocates representing all parts of the diabetes community—people living with and at risk for diabetes, parents and other family members, health care professionals, researchers, and more. RACs convene virtually on a quarterly basis to receive important updates and information about high-impact advocacy opportunities. These meetings are interactive forums providing information on the progress of the American Diabetes Association’s (ADA) advocacy activities to advance favorable policy change for people living with diabetes. When we need powerful voices, RACs are considered our first responders. By joining, you’ll be well-positioned to use your voice, your position, and your network to keep advancing our mission. On top of our regular communications, you’ll get invitations and breaking updates from the ADA asking for help when it matters most. RAC members are first to be invited to speak with lawmakers, join virtual events, talk with the media about diabetes priorities, and more. If you are looking for a new way to support the diabetes community, sign up today and share this opportunity with your family and friends! Get exclusive updates on diabetes policy and funding efforts. Be first to know about key legislative actions impacting people living with diabetes. Connect with fellow advocates and people living with diabetes who share your commitment to making a difference. Be among the first invited to participate in special events. Assist with Diabetes Advocate recruitment at local events (optional). Each RAC is led by one of the ADA’s state government affairs directors: Northeast and Mid-Atlantic (CT, DE, DC, MD, NC, NJ, NY, PA, VA, and VT) Midwest (IA, IL, IN, KY, MI, OH, WI, TN, and WV) South Central and Southeast (AL, AR, FL, GA, LA, MO, MS, OK, SC, and TX) California and Southwest (AZ, CA, CO, HI, NM, NV, and UT) Northwest and North Central (AK, ID, KS, MN, MT, ND, NE, OR, SD, WA, and WY) If you are passionate about making a difference for people living with diabetes in your community and are ready to encourage others to raise their voice for change, join us by signing up for a RAC today! We will need some basic information to ensure we put you in the appropriate RAC. For questions or more information about Regional Advocacy Councils, email grassroots@diabetes.org With your support, the American Diabetes Association® can continue our lifesaving work to make breakthroughs in research and provide people with the resources they need to fight diabetes.
